title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Viral Hepatitis
intro: Herbal creams for viral hepatitis are topical treatments that combine natural herbs with emollients and moisturizers to alleviate symptoms associated with the viral hepatitis ailment. These creams benefit patients by reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and providing relief from fatigue and discomfort. Various examples of herbal creams used to treat viral hepatitis include those infused with silymarin from milk thistle, which helps to protect the liver and promote its natural healing processes; those containing turmeric, which has anti-inflammatory properties; and creams featuring licorice root, which may help to reduce liver inflammation. Additionally, creams with extracts of dandelion root, green tea, and artichoke may also be used to treat viral hepatitis due to their potential to stimulate liver function and detoxify the body.

preparations.preparation_desc: Silybum marianum creams, also known as milk thistle creams, have been used to treat the viral hepatitis ailment due to their hepatoprotective properties. These creams contain silymarin, a bioactive constituent that helps to treat viral hepatitis by inhibiting the replication of the virus and reducing liver inflammation. Silymarin also has antioxidant properties that help to protect liver cells from damage and promote their regeneration, thereby alleviating symptoms of the disease. The benefits of using Silybum marianum creams to treat viral hepatitis include improved liver function, reduced inflammation, and a decrease in symptoms such as fatigue and nausea.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal de pharmacie de Belgique", Silybum marianum creams for viral hepatitis may benefit patients infected with hepatitis B and C, but more data are needed to confirm this.

The bioactive constituents, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, present in Curcuma longa creams, have been shown to possess potent hepatoprotective and antiviral properties, which help to prevent liver damage and viral replication. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams to treat viral hepatitis include reduced liver enzymes, improved liver function, and enhanced immune response, making it a promising natural remedy for this ailment.
